# Benefits Eligibility Policy 2026

## Medical Dental Vision

Full-time employees scheduled for at least 30 hours per week are eligible for
medical, dental, and vision coverage on the first day of the month after 30 days
of employment.

## Enrollment Packet

Benefits enrollment cannot be finalized until the benefits election form is
received. Dependent coverage also requires a dependent attestation.

## Part-Time Rule

Part-time employees scheduled below 30 hours per week are not eligible for the
standard medical plan.
